setDefaultTab("main")
local TEXT_LABEL_ID = "SOULE_SCRIPTS_BOT_V2_0_LABEL"
local TEXTO_COMPLETO = "By zZJester DEV"
local FONT_NAME = "verdana-11px-rounded"
local COR_FUNDO = "#000000"
local COR_PREENCHIMENTO = "#A020F0"
local CORES_PISCADA = {
    "#A020F0",
    "#00FF00",
    "#FF00FF",
    "#FFFFFF"
}
local MACRO_DELAY = 100
local PISCADA_DURACAO_MS = 3000
local PISCADA_TROCA_COR_MS = 300
local PISCADA_ALTERNANCIA_MS = 100
local labelPanel = addLabel(TEXT_LABEL_ID, function() return true end)
labelPanel:setFont(FONT_NAME)
local transitionPoint = -1
local isFilling = true
local piscadaActive = false
local piscadaTimer = 0
local piscadaColorIndex = 1
local function resetToFill()
    isFilling = true
    transitionPoint = -1
    piscadaActive = false
    piscadaTimer = 0
    piscadaColorIndex = 1
end
macro(MACRO_DELAY, function()
    local coloredParts = {}
    if not isFilling and transitionPoint < 0 and not piscadaActive then
        piscadaActive = true
        piscadaTimer = 0
        piscadaColorIndex = 1
    end
    for i = 1, #TEXTO_COMPLETO do
        local char = TEXTO_COMPLETO:sub(i, i)
        local currentColor = COR_FUNDO
        if piscadaActive and i >= (#TEXTO_COMPLETO - 17) then
            if (piscadaTimer % (2 * PISCADA_ALTERNANCIA_MS)) < PISCADA_ALTERNANCIA_MS then
                currentColor = CORES_PISCADA[piscadaColorIndex]
            else
                currentColor = COR_FUNDO
            end
        else
            if isFilling then
                currentColor = (i <= transitionPoint) and COR_PREENCHIMENTO or COR_FUNDO
            else
                currentColor = (i <= transitionPoint) and COR_FUNDO or COR_PREENCHIMENTO
            end
        end
        table.insert(coloredParts, char)
        table.insert(coloredParts, currentColor)
    end
    labelPanel:setColoredText(coloredParts)
    if not piscadaActive then
        if isFilling then
            transitionPoint = transitionPoint + 1
            if transitionPoint > #TEXTO_COMPLETO then
                isFilling = false
                transitionPoint = #TEXTO_COMPLETO
            end
        else
            transitionPoint = transitionPoint - 1
        end
    else
        piscadaTimer = piscadaTimer + MACRO_DELAY
        if piscadaTimer % PISCADA_TROCA_COR_MS == 0 then
            piscadaColorIndex = piscadaColorIndex + 1
            if piscadaColorIndex > #CORES_PISCADA then
                piscadaColorIndex = 1
            end
        end
        if piscadaTimer >= PISCADA_DURACAO_MS then
            resetToFill()
        end
    end
end)

local function setVocSpells(voc)
    local s = vocConfigs[voc]
    if not s then return end
    
    -- 1. Attack Spells
    storage.runeID = s.rune
    storage.spellText = s.safe
    storage.spellText1 = s.ue
    storage.spellText2 = s.target
    storage.fullSpell = s.full
    
    -- Update Attack Widgets
    if w_runeID then w_runeID:setText(tostring(s.rune)) end
    if w_spellText then w_spellText:setText(s.safe) end
    if w_spellText1 then w_spellText1:setText(s.ue) end
    if w_spellText2 then w_spellText2:setText(s.target) end
    if w_fullSpell then w_fullSpell:setText(s.full) end
    
    -- 2. Healing Spells (HP Tab)
    if storage.healing1 then
        storage.healing1.text = s.healLight.text
        storage.healing1.min = s.healLight.min
        storage.healing1.max = s.healLight.max
        storage.healing1.on = true
    end
    if storage.healing2 then
        storage.healing2.text = s.healHeavy.text
        storage.healing2.min = s.healHeavy.min
        storage.healing2.max = s.healHeavy.max
        storage.healing2.on = true
    end

    -- 3. Potions (HP Tab & Auto Pot Module)
    if storage.hpitem1 then storage.hpitem1.item = s.idHp end
    if storage.hpitem2 then storage.hpitem2.item = s.idHp end
    if storage.manaitem1 then storage.manaitem1.item = s.idMana end
    if storage.manaitem2 then storage.manaitem2.item = s.idMana end
    
    -- Update Auto Pot Module (if exists)
    if storage.auto_pot then
        storage.auto_pot.manaId = s.idMana
        storage.auto_pot.hpId = s.idHp
    end

    -- 4. Utils (Utamo, Haste, Anti-Para)
    -- Utamo Vita
    if storage["UTAMO VITA"] then
        storage["UTAMO VITA"].enabled = s.utamo
    end
    
    -- Auto Haste
    if storage.hasteSpell then
        storage.hasteSpell = s.haste
    end
    
    -- Anti Paralyze
    if storage.antiParalyze then
        storage.antiParalyze = s.antiPara
    end
    
    modules.game_textmessage.displayGameMessage("Configuracoes carregadas para: " .. voc)
end

function staminaItems(parent)
  if not parent then
    parent = panel
  end
  local panelName = "staminaItemsUser"
  local ui = setupUI([[
Panel
  height: 65
  margin-top: 2
  SmallBotSwitch
    id: title
    anchors.left: parent.left
    anchors.right: parent.right
    anchors.top: parent.top
    text-align: center
  HorizontalScrollBar
    id: scroll1
    anchors.left: parent.left
    anchors.right: parent.horizontalCenter
    anchors.top: title.bottom
    margin-right: 2
    margin-top: 2
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 42
    step: 1
  HorizontalScrollBar
    id: scroll2
    anchors.left: parent.horizontalCenter
    anchors.right: parent.right
    anchors.top: prev.top
    margin-left: 2
    minimum: 0
    maximum: 42
    step: 1    
  ItemsRow
    id: items
    anchors.left: parent.left
    anchors.right: parent.right
    anchors.top: prev.bottom
  ]], parent)
  ui:setId(panelName)
  if not storage[panelName] then
    storage[panelName] = {
      min = 0,
      max = 40,
    }
  end
  local updateText = function()
    ui.title:setText("" .. storage[panelName].min .. " <= Stamina <= " .. storage[panelName].max .. "")  
  end
  ui.scroll1.onValueChange = function(scroll, value)
    storage[panelName].min = value
    updateText()
  end
  ui.scroll2.onValueChange = function(scroll, value)
    storage[panelName].max = value
    updateText()
  end
  ui.scroll1:setValue(storage[panelName].min)
  ui.scroll2:setValue(storage[panelName].max)
  ui.title:setOn(storage[panelName].enabled)
  ui.title.onClick = function(widget)
    storage[panelName].enabled = not storage[panelName].enabled
    widget:setOn(storage[panelName].enabled)
  end
  if type(storage[panelName].items) ~= 'table' then
    storage[panelName].items = { 31335 }
  end
  for i=1,5 do
    ui.items:getChildByIndex(i).onItemChange = function(widget)
      storage[panelName].items[i] = widget:getItemId()
    end
    ui.items:getChildByIndex(i):setItemId(storage[panelName].items[i])    
  end
  macro(500, function()
    if not storage[panelName].enabled or stamina() / 60 < storage[panelName].min or stamina() / 60 > storage[panelName].max then
      return
    end
    local candidates = {}
    for i, item in pairs(storage[panelName].items) do
      if item >= 100 then
        table.insert(candidates, item)
      end
    end
    if #candidates == 0 then
      return
    end    
    use(candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)])
  end)
end

local function properTable(t)
    local r = {}
    for _, entry in pairs(t) do
      table.insert(r, entry.id)
    end
    return r
end
macro(200, function()
    if not config.enabled then return end
    local tables = {properTable(config.capItems), properTable(config.useItems), properTable(config.trashItems)}
    local containers = getContainers()
    for i=1,3 do
        for _, container in pairs(containers) do
            for __, item in ipairs(container:getItems()) do
                for ___, userItem in ipairs(tables[i]) do
                    if item:getId() == userItem then
                        return i == 1 and freecap() < 150 and dropItem(item) or
                               i == 2 and use(item) or
                               i == 3 and dropItem(item)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
